rules: Use project.py as the semantic guardian of project state.
Maintain scripts, code and repository for LLM cognition and execution.
Do not create parallel human technical documentation by default.
Human-facing reading belongs in an explicitly requested human manual or UI.
Keep secrets, mutable databases, caches and generated exports out of Git.
Treat public copy as a governed projection of source-backed claims, not as marketing prose.
Build localized pages from shared templates and validated catalogs; never hand-maintain duplicated HTML.
